listings.title: 2011 Cervélo P2 carbon (Medium) + HED Jet 6/9 wheels + Tacx Flow, moving sale
listings.verdict: Worth ~$1,750 for bike + HED wheels (~$1,900 with the Tacx Flow); all-in ~$1,310 if it closes at $1,150 (close $1,150 + tune-up $120 + bar tape $30 + gas $10). A steal only at $1,150 or less. Moving sale, 11 weeks up, already down from $2,300.
notes: Model/year: 2011 Cervélo P2, full carbon, "Medium". 2011 P2 sizes 48/51/54/56/58; Medium likely 54 (stack ~525, reach ~408 from memory of the Cervélo chart, not confirmed this run). Ask the exact size.

Package: HED Jet RC6 front / RC9 rear "Performance" (alloy brake track under a carbon fairing, so fine with rim brakes; confirm HED hubs), training wheelset, ISM + Fizik saddles, new Continental tyres, 4 tubes, rear bottle cage, Tacx Flow smart trainer, fan. Pedals not included.
Groupset not stated: ask. Bar tape on the aerobars looks white and worn in the photo: counted $30.

Value evidence: P2 carbon asks this run $1,300 (P2C 48, Ottawa), $1,400 (P2-SL, Guelph; P2C, Brampton; P2 carbon 48, Burlington), $1,000 (P2 2010, Lévis) → about $1,150-1,200 at 85%. HED Jet 6/9 Performance pair ~$600 used (estimate, not checked on Pinkbike this run). Tacx Flow ~$150. BBB not checked.
Ryan already has a ThinkRider: the draft asks for a price without the trainer and fan.
Seller text: "Serious buyers only, cash only, local pickup." No scam signals.
2026-09-27 23:00: Ryan sent the opening himself. The sent bubble contains the text twice back to back (probably a double paste).

thread.text: Hi! Is this still available? Is the Medium a 54 frame, and how tall are you? Any crashes, and what groupset is it (10 or 11 speed)? Are the HED wheels on HED hubs? I already have a trainer, so what's the best you could do cash for the bike and both wheelsets without the Tacx and fan? I'm in Laval and can come by this week.
